text: Catalog type references shall be ordered field IDs for records/tuples, one pointee ID for pointers, one signature ID for function refs, and empty for integer/runtime carriers. Signatures shall separately carry parameter/result/raised references. Inapplicable nullable fields shall be null, arrays empty, and variadic false.
